en: Black‑and‑white view across a calm river or lake toward an ornate iron bridge with decorative lampposts and stone pylons. Behind the bridge stands a large neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance style complex with steep roofs, turrets, spires, and pointed arched windows, partly obscured by leafless trees. The buildings, bridge, and trees are reflected in the still water in the foreground. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image.
